title: Street-View Image Generation From a Bird's-Eye View Layout
control_family: layout, box, map or BEV conditioning

output_modality.value: multi-view street-view images (single frame, surrounding cameras); no video

control_signal.value: BEV layout of HD map and traffic actors (21 channels on nuScenes) plus per-camera intrinsics and extrinsics

control_mechanism.value: BEV layout is tokenised by a VQ-VAE; an autoregressive transformer attends globally to BEV tokens, with camera-derived spatial embeddings and a pairwise camera attention bias

base_model.value: VQ-VAE image and BEV tokenisers plus a GPT-like autoregressive transformer (24 layers, 16 heads); no pretrained image or video backbone stated

datasets.value: nuScenes (resampled to about 260k training instances) and Argoverse 2; layouts from projected 3D boxes

metrics.value: FID; road and vehicle mIoU from a pre-trained CVT segmentation network; View Consistency Score; detection mAP and NDS for augmentation

controllability_evidence.value: CVT on generated images: road mIoU 50.20, vehicle mIoU 5.89 (real-image model: 66.31 and 27.51); FID 25.54 on nuScenes; augmentation adds 0.6 mIoU road and vehicle

closed_loop.value: no; open-loop image generation, with layouts also taken from the MetaDrive simulator or edited by users

stated_limitations.value: Limited ability to generate individual vehicles recognised by the segmentation network; small-object synthesis remains hard and is left for future work

notes: Early image-only scene generator, not a temporal world model. View Consistency Score 5.65 (nuScenes) versus 12.86 for real images.
